 This Mfa Is Filed U/S 173(1) Of Mv Act Against The
Judgment And Award Dated 28.02.2014 Passed In Mvc
No.5916/2012 On The File Of The Additional Judge,
Member, Mact, Court Of Small Causes, Mayo Hall Unit,
Bangalore, Awarding Compensation Of Rs.1,29,320/-
With Interest @ 6% P.A. From The Date Of Petition Till
Realization.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

This is an appeal filed by the owner of the vehicle aggrieved by the Award dated 28.02.2014 passed in M.V.C.No.5916/2012 whereby the Court below had granted compensation of an amount of Rs.1,29,320/- which is payable by the owner of the vehicle on the ground NC: 2023:KHC:33833 that the driver of the vehicle was not having a valid driving license to drive the vehicle.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the claimant submits that they have filed an application under Order 41 Rule 27 of C.P.C., to receive the driving license of the driver of the vehicle which shows that he is having a driving license to drive the heavy goods vehicle.
It is submitted that they could not produce this document before the Court below as such, the Court below came to such conclusion.
To the said application no objections are filed by the Respondent.

3. Considering the evidence filed before this Court under Order 41 Rule 27 of C.P.C., the license in favour of the driver of the vehicle to drive the said heavy goods vehicle, the order under appeal is set aside and the matter is remanded back to the Trial Court for fresh consideration.

The parties shall appear before the Court below on 30.10.2023 without any further notice and the NC:
2023:KHC:33833 court below shall decide the case within a period of two months from the date of receipt of the copy of the order.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and remanded.
